name: Nicaraguan Sign Language

earlier_scan.source_named: Sign language (no spoken word stress); literature (Senghas et al.) covers emergence/grammar, no word-stress description exists.

sources.citation: Kocab, A., Senghas, A. & Coppola, M. 2023. Potentially recursive structures emerge quickly when a new language community forms. Cognition 241:105619.

sources.citation: Brentari, D., Ergin, R., Senghas, A. & Cho, P.W. 2021. Community interactions and phonemic inventories in emerging sign languages. Phonology 38(3). doi:10.1017/S0952675721000336
